messages.dangers.defeated: One bite too many: the spear-bearer crumbles to dust.
messages.dangers.left_fight: You back out of the fight. %s awaits your next visit.
messages.dangers.left_fight_plural: You back out of the fight. %s await your next visit.
messages.dangers.heka_controls: Hold [shift] while striking to use magic on the red crocodiles. Don't waste magic on the plain ones: they'll make off with your power.

dangers.e31.instructions: Spear each crocodile before it reaches you.

feedback.controls: Press [space] to strike; use [↑] [↓] to move.
feedback.first_crocodile: Here comes one. Press [space] to strike.
feedback.heka_break: The crocodiles draw back. Above, signs begin to glow red.
feedback.heka_on_normal_crocodile: Magic spent on an ordinary crocodile! It seizes the word of power and makes off with it. The crocodiles are not turned back.
feedback.crocodile_escaped: A crocodile slips past you to the wall and gleefully steals away with your word of power.
feedback.red_crocodile: A red crocodile needs a red spear. The signs glowing above may say how.
feedback.tutorial_bite: The crocodile reached you. Your spear is supposed to reach it first.

dangers.e32.instructions: Crocodiles come from both sides now. Turn and spear each one.
dangers.e32.success: The crocodiles of the four quarters are turned back.

feedback.controls_both: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) move you; [←] [→] turn you.
